# sqlpipe v2.0

This major release redesigns the user model, adds a resumable sync mode, and significantly speeds up Parquet output.

## Breaking changes
The `name` field on `/v2/users` has been split into `first_name` and `last_name`. Update any clients that read or write `name` to use the two new fields instead. Existing records require a one-time migration to populate the split fields.

## New features
- `--incremental` flag for resumable syncs that pick up where the last run left off — ideal for large or recurring transfers.

## Performance
- Parquet writes are now ~40% faster thanks to an improved column encoder and buffered flushing.
